subject: Fictional visibly adult female portrait subject, face and hair appearance referenced from the supplied photo
setting: Restored indoor ferry terminal at autumn dusk
event: Seated pause midway through folding a paper route map as travelers move behind the bench
visual_priorities: A seated head-and-elbows triangle is legible through supported asymmetric forearms.
A level mirror-symmetrical architectural frame contrasts with the asymmetric seated pose.
A crisp stationary face and map contrast with directional moving traveler trails.
The face remains readable and visibly guided by the supplied face and hair appearance.
baseline_prompt_en: An environmental editorial photograph inside a restored indoor ferry terminal at autumn dusk. A fictional adult woman is seated on the broad central stone bench; use the supplied image solely for visible face and hair appearance, with a dark chin-length bob, wispy parted bangs, dark eyes and the visible facial contours. She has paused midway through folding a creased paper route map across her lap and looks toward the camera with a quietly attentive expression. Her hips rest fully on the bench, her left foot rests on the floor, and her right foot rests on a low stone step. Her separated knees support her forearms, with the right elbow higher than the left; her head is the upper apex and the two outward elbows form the lower corners of a clear seated triangle. Her shoulders tilt gently and her head leans slightly toward the lower shoulder, creating an asymmetrical pose. The camera faces the exact central doorway: matching arched passages and paired wall lamps mirror each other on both sides, with upright columns and level floor seams. A wicker basket of dried hydrangeas sits beside the bench. Behind the bench, two travelers cross laterally through the paired passages as translucent directional motion trails, while her eyes, facial contours, hands and folded map remain crisp and stationary. The bench and architecture are sharply resolved too. Warm light from the two wall lamps meets cool overcast entrance light, with a brief soft frontal flash making the face readable during the slow exposure. Frame from her head through both feet, large enough to read both eyes, retaining the bench supports and both symmetrical passageways.
